answer: The most convincing defense prices identity creation on scarce work history: an account earns full rights only after a verifiable log of completed tasks, and registration fees escalate per batch, so spawning a mesa of fake agents costs more than any payout returns. Each identity's signal is its cross-signed work history, expensive to fake. A whisper network of attestation nodes flags coordinated registrations and nullifies clones sharing infrastructure, forcing attackers to build costly genuine-looking histories for every identity.
